locations.note: Jonathan Harker searches Dracula's old home at Carfax Abbey and Seward's asylum, escapes a fake Transylvanian bedroom built inside Dracula's Styx cinema, then burns Carfax while Seward blows up the Styx.
Jonathan sees Dracula slip into a secret tomb at Highgate, and later follows Hopkins's note inside, where Dracula tells him he is taking Mina back to Transylvania.
Jonathan enters the castle through the mines, finds Radu's diamond in an ancient prison and, with the Dragon Ring made whole, destroys Dracula in the Last Sanctuary.

routes.name: Jonathan Harker
routes.note: From Carfax Abbey and Highgate Cemetery in London back to Dracula's castle in Transylvania.
